subject: S18 outbox entity list + LWW/Idempotency-Key contract (ack needed: seg16-planner, seg17-pathway)
body:
# S18 outbox entity list (contract) — `apps/web/src/offline/`, Dexie db `naadi-v1`

One `outbox` table per device, rows `{op_id (uuidv7), user_id, entity, key, method, path, body, client_updated_at_ms, queued_at, attempts, next_at, state: queued|sending|failed, last_error}`.
Every op is sent with header `Idempotency-Key: <op_id>`; LWW bodies carry `client_updated_at_ms` (device ms, adjusted by the S09/S12b server clock offset).
Replay: on `online`, `visibilitychange`→visible, app start, every 30 s while pending; FIFO per entity, parallel across entities; exp. backoff (2 s → 5 min);
4xx other than 408/409/425/429 parks the op as `failed` (Retry / Discard in the sync sheet). Nothing is dropped silently.

| entity | key | endpoint (owner) | server rule | coalesce |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `attempt` | `{block_id}:{question_id}` | `POST /api/blocks/{id}/attempts` (S08/S09) | first answer stands, idempotent per (block, question); late replay → 409/422 `time_up` shown "Not counted: time was up" | latest unsent per key |
| `card_review` | `client_review_id` | `POST /api/cards/{id}/review` (S10) | append-only, idempotent on review id, ordered by `reviewed_at` | never |
| `ink` | `{surface_type}:{surface_id}` | `POST /api/ink/{type}/{id}/changes` (S12b) | merge by item id (`mergeInkItems`, unchanged) | merged per surface |
| `note` / `highlight` | note id | `POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/notes[/{id}]` (S13) | LWW per row | fields merged into one op |
| `notebook` (+ pages, order) | notebook id / page id | `/api/notebooks/**` (S13) | LWW per row | existing S13 enqueue rules |
| `plan_item` | item id | `POST /api/plan/items/{id}/status` (S16/S11) | LWW per row | latest |
| `user_pathway_task` | task id | S17 status endpoint | LWW per row | latest |
| `cost` | cost id | S17 costs endpoints | LWW per row; delete = tombstone | latest |
| `reading_position` | chapter id | `PUT /api/reading-position` (S06) | LWW per row | latest |

LWW rule (shared helper `naadi_api/sync/lww.py::apply_lww`, golden vectors shared with TS): stored wins unless `incoming.client_updated_at_ms > stored` (ties → server); incoming clamped to `server_now + 5 min`;
deletes write `sync_tombstones(user, entity, key, client_updated_at_ms)` so a later-replayed older edit loses, a newer edit resurrects. Response = the stored row (+ `"applied": bool`); client adopts it and,
when `applied=false`, keeps its losing version in `conflicts` (7 days) and shows "Changed on another device".
Idempotency: `sync_ops(user, op_id, status, response, created_at)` 24 h, backend-only (no client grants).

**Never queued** (disabled offline with a reason): vault uploads, ingest uploads, assistant messages, generation, admin writes.

**Asks**
- seg16-planner: add `client_updated_at_ms` on `plan_items` (your migration) and call `apply_lww` in the status endpoint; `sw.ts` — you create it with push handlers, I claim it after your first integrate to add Workbox precache/runtime caching (no /api caching). Please ack.
- seg17-pathway: same for `user_pathway_tasks` and `costs` (+ cost delete as tombstone). Please ack.
- S13 (notes/notebooks) and S06 (reading_positions): I add the column in my migration and switch the endpoints to `apply_lww` + `Idempotency-Key`; owners, please agree.
- seg12b-ink: `inkPending` moves into the outbox as entity `ink`; transport + merge unchanged.
- seg21-author: Settings → Offline group lives in `apps/web/src/offline/SettingsOfflineGroup.tsx`; I need one mount point in your settings screen.
